meta.soil: site soil (SoilGrids) at the pilots (Chiquimula, Jutiapa); loam at Zacapa. Rainfed, flat, no irrigation, one crop per run from 1 April (bare soil before sowing).
meta.reading: rank 1 = the worst of the usable years; percentile = mid-rank share of usable years with a lower relYield (0 = worst, 1 = best); badYear = percentile <= 1/3 (the worst third, fixed beforehand). relYield is 0 when the cycle does not finish before 31 March.
meta.usableYearRule: a source-year with any missing rain day in 1 April..31 March is excluded for that site and source (not filled)

rainPercentile.note: 0 = driest of the years, 1 = wettest (for the dry spell, 0 = longest spell)
